units.source_text: 走完那排踏石，岸边松树林立，转眼间来到了桥殿。

en.t: After crossing that row of stepping stones, with pine trees standing along the bank, they soon arrived at the bridge pavilion.

units.source_text: 这里的正式名字叫“泰平阁”，这座桥令人联想到“殿”的样子。

en.t: Its formal name was Taihei-kaku, and the bridge called to mind the appearance of a palace hall.

units.source_text: 桥两侧有矮靠背折椅，人们坐在这里憩息，可以越过水池眺望庭园的景色。

en.t: On both sides of the bridge were folding chairs with low backs, where people could sit and rest while looking across the pond at the garden scenery.

units.source_text: 不，当然应该说这是有水池的庭园。

en.t: No, of course one should say that it was a garden with a pond.
